description: the expected randoms of a pair of detection bins (a, b) in coincidence (summed over all TOF bins) are singles[a] * singles[b] and are uniformly distributed over the TOF bins (see python/randoms.py); singles[a] * singles[b] = coincidence_window_ns * acquisition_time_ns * singles_rates_per_ns[a] * singles_rates_per_ns[b] (constant singles rates)
